method: Read all345 exact propositions, all65 complete context profiles and the complete original contradiction-caption scope against full base2275–2674 and exact controlling precedence/due references. Verify every original payload and all1385 ordered bindings with exact insertion-split occurrence fragments. Fourteen independent corrections distinguish unchanged isolation/authorized historical-pattern permissions, byte-loss and future guards, uniform proof discipline, accepted sufficiency relation and release-contradiction class definitions from actual current computations. Preserve15 exact predecessor indentation qualifications. Proposal archive is mirrored from verified private Library custody metadata; no implementation/test/proof files or source-generator contents consulted

decisions.PRESERVED_INDEPENDENCE: Exact context-independence evaluator input/output vocabulary, ten distinct current run contexts sharing candidate identity, no cross-run/reviewer/RCA/correction contamination and Stage12/23/24 role separation remain. F2 input support is distinct from independence; no echo establishes hidden provider separation or overrides a mandatory UNKNOWN dimension.
decisions.PRESERVED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW: Exact review identity/hash/context/reservation/evidence/question/disposition/reconciliation metadata and separate author/reviewer/reconciler roles remain. No self-approval or automatic promotion of conflicting outputs; technical third review and actual human-authority limits remain as stated.
decisions.PRESERVED_DIMENSIONED_INDEPENDENCE: The seven named dimensions, application-observable limits and blocking/undetermined consequence for required UNKNOWN remain. Distinct identifiers and F2 echoes do not establish provider state, environment independence or user-transfer conformity.
decisions.PRESERVED_BLIND_ALIASES: Use aliases only when true identity is unnecessary, proposition fidelity is preserved and bias possible; retain true identity when required. Application owns generation, durable stable hidden mapping, prompt binding and returned-ID remapping; reviewer-supplied/altered mappings remain rejected.
decisions.PRESERVED_PROMPT_CATEGORIES_AND_EXCLUSIO: Each exact permitted prompt category and prohibited generator/other-verifier/comparison/RCA/correction/prior-review category remains with its actual stage condition. Current content values may change elsewhere without changing these disclosure/isolation permissions. No warning cures embedded forbidden context.
decisions.PRESERVED_EVIDENCE_OUTPUT_SCHEMA: The shared sufficiency evaluator output members remain sufficient/reasons/requiredEvidenceClasses/presentEvidenceIds/currentArtifactIds. This preserves output structure, not any actual favorable evaluation or current evidence value.
decisions.PRESERVED_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS: Exact current app-hashed bytes/identities/scope, actual meaning observations with evidence comparison, evidence records/returned artifacts and attributable human/system observation remain required. Prose, filenames, hashes alone, AI claims of human inspection and UNAVAILABLE cannot establish satisfaction; F2 does not waive stronger proof.
decisions.PRESERVED_SHARED_EVIDENCE_AND_HISTORY: Every named stage uses the same shared evidence evaluator rather than a stage-local reimplementation. Preserve historical executions. Current computation is reviewed separately; a new route does not convert historical evidence into current satisfaction.
decisions.PRESERVED_ACTIVATION_AND_FUTURE_INVARIAN: Own current activation proof/identified parent leaf, no agent-only activation truth, UNKNOWN applicability and complete downstream invalidation remain. Future obligations remain scheduled in their closed universe, with no false execution or premature missing status.
decisions.PRESERVED_THREE_VALUED_LOGIC: Exact truth/basis/currentness/freshness/contradiction metadata and TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN logic remain. TRUE needs affirmative sufficient support; FALSE needs current negative evidence and missing-data FALSE requires closed universe. Contradictory sufficient evidence is never averaged away; F2 support and optional unanswered requests supply no truth.
decisions.PRESERVED_PROOF_LANGUAGE_AND_SUFFICIENCY: One primary proposition/current proof, independent EQUIVALENT sameness and exact LEAF/ALL_OF/ANY_OF/AT_LEAST_K truth/branch sufficiency rules remain. No arbitrary code, stale/empty node, unrestricted negation, coercion or advisory/historical/optional/unregistered satisfaction. B uses this existing language rather than introducing another.
decisions.PRESERVED_OBSERVATION_AND_ATTESTATION: Exact evidence-observation-proposition path and metadata, accepted entailment relations, freshness/acyclicity and registered external-attestation identity/input/method/failure rules remain. Only accepted ESTABLISHES supplies affirmative proof; support/context and normalization cannot elevate external claims.
decisions.PRESERVED_CLASSIFICATION_EXCEPTION_MATER: Closed classification/severity/materiality vocabularies, uncertainty blocking, independent obligation-reduction review and genuine scope-change/waiver authority remain. No exception or severity label turns violation into satisfaction; NONMATERIAL needs affirmative no-impact reasoning. Sufficient mandatory refutation retains REJECTED precedence.
decisions.PRESERVED_CONTRADICTION_INVARIANTS: Current-scope-only derived contradictions, same-proposition comparison, hash-versus-meaning distinction, historical/artifact/baseline identity boundaries and defense in depth remain. Sufficient mandatory refutation controls REJECTED, otherwise required unresolved evidence blocks; all contradictions remain recorded and gate-integrated.
decisions.EXACT_CONTRADICTION_CLASS_GOVERNOR: Retain the exact required-contradiction caption and all original governed range/ID occurrences. No adjacent release rule or new amendment clause is absorbed, and no covered individual is silently dropped.
decisions.CURRENT_ALLOWED_VERIFICATION_PROJECTION: The candidate treats current context values as a new scope for generic isolation rules. Each exact projection/restriction predicate is independently corrected below: all current response/source/test inputs must meet their own changed contracts without changing the original exposure boundary.
decisions.CURRENT_AUTHORIZED_FAILURE_HISTORY: The candidate imports current deferred-execution compatibility into historical-pattern exposure permissions. Each exact atom is corrected below; current F1 executions and their accepted binding/history identities remain separately governed, while authorized historical patterns are not silently restricted to current executable tests.
decisions.CURRENT_EVIDENCE_EVALUATOR: The actual shared sufficiency computation consumes applicable A current response values, B accepted availability, D native semantic identities/outcomes, E normalized reviewed variance and F1/F2 compatible actual execution/input bases. Preserve stronger evidence, current review, freshness and dimensioned independence. A source function name is not conformance evidence.
decisions.CURRENT_PROGRAMMATIC_EVIDENCE: Actual registered runtime/external capability, execution result, exact input identity and current test-spec evidence must bind D current semantics, E relevant reviewed test/variance and F1 genuine distinct execution subjects/targets with F2 route-specific basis. An obsolete result, reused pre/post observation or unbound echo cannot satisfy these current evidence bindings.
decisions.CURRENT_DEPENDENT_BYTE_AVAILABILITY: The candidate treats the unchanged lost-byte invalidation guard as new semantics. The exact guard is independently retained below; current availability and execution input identity computations remain separately changed and never replaced by a digest claim.
decisions.CURRENT_ACTIVATION_PROOF_RULES: The exact cross-category uniform-proof discipline is independently retained below; actual activation proofs must nevertheless satisfy each applicable current rule, with no alternative language or downgraded evidence.
decisions.CURRENT_DUE_EVIDENCE_TARGET_TRIGGER: Actual DUE_NOW sufficiency selection consumes B current reviewed availability and F1 compatible deferred prerequisites. Separate before-target-exists no-satisfied/no-violated/no-missing protections are independently retained because B2050 expressly preserves phase timing and unknown is not absence.
decisions.CURRENT_PROOF_OBLIGATION_CONTENT: Actual current proof expression/leaves/evidence bases/artifact/dependency/freshness/independence/timing/satisfaction/blocker/scope bindings reference applicable B/D/E/F current semantic contracts and exact current identities. The unchanged one-proof cardinality and proof grammar do not grandfather old content or weaker input support as sufficiency.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_LEAF_TRUTH_EXTRACTION: Actual declared leaf truth extraction must consume D selected assertion disposition, not Boolean data, and distinguish definition rejection, prestart BLOCKED, started-data UNDETERMINED and runtime EXECUTION_FAILED. B preserves accepted existing proof-language TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN and current evidence scope.
decisions.CURRENT_PROOF_SUFFICIENCY_REVIEW: The exact sufficiency-relation type and accepted-review authority are independently retained below. Actual newly authored/installed availability expression and current native/variance review content remain governed by B/D/E without redefining the relation as EQUIVALENT or treating FROZEN as accepted.
decisions.CURRENT_CONTRADICTION_COMPUTATION: Actual current contradiction detection and rejection of materially different determinations consume applicable A/B/D/E/F current meanings, exact REQ×RUN×TEST/scope and current sufficient evidence. Distinct propositions/historical versions are not automatically contradictory and minimum echo is not sufficient refutation.
decisions.CURRENT_RELEASE_CONTRADICTION_TRIGGERS: The candidate treats the three unchanged release-contradiction class examples as new current computations. Each is independently retained below; actual current blocker/violation/evidence-validity calculations still consume their applicable changed source duties.
decisions.CORRECTION_2447: Base2321 is the Stage12 independence restriction to only the allowed verification projection, read with exact28.2 allowed/excluded categories. A–F2 introduces no permission for another verifier conclusion, comparison, RCA or correction and F2 2551 preserves distinct independence. Changed current input/test content is governed elsewhere; this isolation predicate is retained rather than attaching all amendment scopes through a broad context.
decisions.CORRECTION_2516: Base2404–2405 requires actual selected context to match stated restrictions and rejects a mere warning when prohibited information is embedded. A–F2 changes some admissible content values, not this equality/isolation boundary or the exact stage-specific allowlists. Retain the generic context-conformity predicate; actual inputs still satisfy their own current contracts.
decisions.CORRECTION_2456: Base2334 and2452–2453 authorize only the bounded Stage24 historical failure/regression-pattern projection, with exact2455–2459 exclusions. B2048 and F2 2547/2549/2551 preserve rather than replace this requirement. Current byte/input identity computation changes separately; neither an echo nor historical execution rescues this guard.
decisions.CORRECTION_2600: Base2554 requires activation propositions to use the same proof/evidence/review discipline as other release-bearing propositions. B retains that existing proof language and F2 2551 preserves stronger/distinct proof requirements. This cross-category uniformity constraint is unchanged; actual current proof contents are separately governed. Do not manufacture an alternative activation rule or attach every amended computation to the uniformity atom.

B2050 expressly does not change that due predicate/phase timing; F1 1195 preserves legitimately future visible/unexecuted work. The protection is unchanged and does not equate unknown target availability to known absence. Actual DUE_NOW selection is separately changed.
